# libghostty-vt in vqro: provenance and notice inventory

**What.** Ghostty's terminal emulation library (libghostty-vt). The TUI's `libghostty` terminal engine links it
statically.

**Pin.** Source dist `libghostty-vt-1.3.2-HEAD-+c5a21edfc`, Ghostty commit c5a21edfcbc2d5b46540ad91b7980aca31f5f1f3
(`libghostty-vt.vendor.json`). It builds with Zig 0.15.2. Current upstream needs Zig 0.16, so the pin is not bumped
without a decision.

**Provenance.** The tree was copied unchanged from herdr's `vendor/` (herdr commit a5c69bea, `~/Projects/herdr`),
including herdr's two local patches (`libghostty-vt.patches.md`). `scripts/check_vendor.py` checks each file against
`libghostty-vt.sha256` and checks that the patches are applied.

**What the static library contains.** Taken from `ar t` of a `-Demit-lib-vt -Doptimize=ReleaseFast` build of this
tree on x86_64-linux-gnu, 2026-11-20:
- Ghostty's VT code;
- Ghostty's SIMD helpers (`codepoint_width`, `index_of`, `base64`, `vt`);
- Google Highway;
- simdutf;
- Zig's compiler_rt.

uucode's Unicode tables are compiled into the VT code. Other Zig packages that `zig build` fetches (libxev, vaxis,
wayland, z2d, ...) are not linked into lib-vt.

| Component | Where it comes from | Licence | Notice to retain |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ghostty (libghostty-vt) | `vendor/libghostty-vt` | MIT | `vendor/libghostty-vt/LICENSE`: "Copyright (c) 2024 Mitchell Hashimoto, Ghostty contributors" |
| Google Highway 1.2.0 (`highway-66486a10…`) | Zig package (`pkg/highway/build.zig.zon`, lazy) | Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause | its `LICENSE` and `LICENSE-BSD3` ("Copyright (c) The Highway Project Authors") |
| simdutf (amalgamated) | `vendor/libghostty-vt/pkg/simdutf/vendor/simdutf.cpp` | Apache-2.0 OR MIT (upstream simdutf). The amalgamated file carries no licence header: G7 adds the upstream LICENSE-MIT text verbatim. | upstream simdutf licence text |
| uucode 0.2.0 | Zig package (`build.zig.zon`) | MIT ("Copyright (c) 2026 Jacob Sandlund"), plus its `licenses/LICENSE_unicode` (Unicode-3.0) for the UCD data and `licenses/LICENSE_Bjoern_Hoehrmann` (MIT) | `LICENSE.md` and both files in its `licenses/` |
| Zig compiler_rt | the Zig 0.15.2 toolchain (`lib/compiler_rt`) | MIT (Zig's `LICENSE`); parts derive from LLVM compiler-rt (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception) | Zig's `LICENSE` |
| FFI declarations | `src/tui/ghostty/bindings.rs`, generated by rust-bindgen from the headers above; copied from herdr | Apache-2.0 (herdr) | NOTICE line (G7) |

All of these are on vqro's licence allowlist (Apache-2.0, MIT, BSD-3-Clause, Unicode-3.0, Apache-2.0 WITH
LLVM-exception). G7 puts the texts into `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` through `scripts/license_check.py`, which will
also check that this inventory is complete.
